name: THC Education Visual Production Queue — Wave 02
purpose: Next production wave after the initial Harvest and Outdoor sets. Prioritizes diagnostic photography, measurement, lighting, IPM, and advanced post-harvest visuals.

designStandard.visualStyle: photorealistic academic studio imagery with restrained scientific overlays
designStandard.minimumMaster: 2400x3000 PNG or equivalent high-resolution portrait master
designStandard.branding: THC — Teaching Healthy Cultivation + dtfseeds.com; branding secondary to education
rules: No universal numeric targets without context and evidence
Prefer short labels, diagnostic comparisons, workflow panels and measurement diagrams
Spell-check all baked-in text before publication
Keep observational evidence separate from interpretation

items.title: Trichome Sampling & Microscope Technique
items.purpose: Show calyx vs sugar-leaf sampling, multiple flower locations, consistent magnification/lighting, and why a single sample can mislead.

items.title: Harvest Contamination Triage
items.purpose: Photoreal comparison of normal resin, loose debris, insect residue, suspected mildew, rot and mold with inspect/segregate decision logic.

items.title: Moisture Migration During Drying
items.purpose: Explain surface-to-interior moisture gradients and why exterior feel alone is an incomplete drying endpoint.

items.title: Drying Curve & Endpoint Measurement
items.purpose: Show time, mass loss, moisture content, water activity and stability as complementary process observations rather than a single folk endpoint.

items.title: How to Measure Water Activity
items.purpose: Show representative sampling, sample cup loading, equilibration, temperature awareness, repeated readings and batch variability.

items.title: Packaging & Container Properties
items.purpose: Compare light barrier, moisture barrier, oxygen exchange, headspace and physical protection without declaring one container universally best.

items.title: Post-Harvest Laboratory Testing
items.purpose: Explain representative batch sampling for cannabinoids, terpenes, water activity/moisture and microbial testing.

items.title: Batch Traceability & Harvest Records
items.purpose: Show batch ID, cultivar, harvest time, trim method, drying zone, environmental trends, curing/storage records and deviations.

items.title: Fresh-Frozen vs Dried/Cured Pathways
items.purpose: Branch the workflow clearly between material preserved for fresh-frozen processing and material intended for controlled drying/curing.

items.title: PPFD: Measuring Photon Density
items.purpose: Photoreal canopy measurement map explaining PPFD, sensor orientation, measurement grid and uneven fixture output.

items.title: DLI: Light Accumulated Over a Day
items.purpose: Connect PPFD and photoperiod to daily light integral with visually clear examples and contextualized calculations.

items.title: PAR, Photons & Plant Response
items.purpose: Explain PAR as a measurement range and distinguish photon quantity from spectrum and plant response.

items.title: Canopy Light Uniformity Mapping
items.purpose: Show multi-point PPFD mapping, hot spots, edge falloff, fixture height and canopy geometry.

items.title: Light Stress: Observation vs Diagnosis
items.purpose: Compare bleaching, leaf-angle changes, heat stress and unrelated look-alikes while reinforcing multi-signal diagnosis.

items.title: Photoperiod & Dark-Period Integrity
items.purpose: Explain timers, uninterrupted dark periods, light leaks and measurement without overgeneralizing cultivar responses.

items.title: Spectrum: What Changes and What Does Not
items.purpose: Explain spectral distribution, morphology-related responses and why spectrum does not replace adequate photon delivery.

items.title: Fixture Height, Coverage & Tradeoffs
items.purpose: Visualize intensity, footprint, uniformity and heat-management tradeoffs as fixture distance changes.

items.title: Light Measurement Errors
items.purpose: Show common errors including tilted sensors, smartphone-only estimates, too few sample points and measuring above rather than at canopy.

items.title: Scouting Pattern: Where to Look First
items.purpose: Photoreal plant inspection sequence covering leaf undersides, new growth, stems, media surface and sticky-card context.

items.title: Spider Mite Identification
items.purpose: Macro comparison of mites, eggs, stippling, webbing and non-mite look-alikes.

items.title: Thrips Identification
items.purpose: Macro comparison of adults/larvae, feeding scars, frass and common look-alikes.

items.title: Fungus Gnats: Adults, Larvae & Root-Zone Context
items.purpose: Show life stages, sticky-card adults, larvae near media and why adult counts alone do not quantify root injury.

items.title: Powdery Mildew vs Residue
items.purpose: Photoreal diagnostic comparison of powdery mildew, mineral/spray residue, trichomes and dust.

items.title: Botrytis / Bud Rot Progression
items.purpose: Show external warning signs, internal flower damage and segregation logic without implying visual inspection proves microbiological safety.

items.title: Root Health: Normal vs Stressed
items.purpose: Compare healthy roots with low-oxygen, physical damage, salt-stress and disease-like appearances while avoiding single-image diagnosis.

items.title: Differential Diagnosis Decision Tree
items.purpose: Route symptoms through location, pattern, environment, irrigation, roots, pH/EC, pest evidence and progression before assigning a likely cause.

items.title: Measurement Quality: Accuracy, Precision & Resolution
items.purpose: Explain the three concepts using cultivation instruments and repeated measurements.

items.title: Representative Sampling
items.purpose: Show why measurements from one leaf, bud, pot or canopy point may not represent an entire plant or batch.

items.title: Calibration & Verification
items.purpose: Show calibration/reference checks for pH, EC, temperature/RH and light instruments without implying all sensors use the same procedure.

items.title: Trend Data vs One-Time Readings
items.purpose: Demonstrate how time-series data reveals drift, cycling and transient events that a single reading can miss.

items.title: Observation → Hypothesis → Test → Compare
items.purpose: Teach a simple evidence workflow for cultivation troubleshooting rather than immediate causal claims.

items.title: Confounding Variables in Grow Experiments
items.purpose: Visualize how genetics, environment, irrigation, plant size and measurement timing can distort a comparison.

items.title: Cultivation Recordkeeping That Supports Diagnosis
items.purpose: Show a concise log structure for environmental data, irrigation, pH/EC, plant observations, interventions and outcomes.
